name: The Effect of Low-Bit Quantization on Memorization and Factual Recall in Language Models: A Multi-Model Study
description: A multi-model (6-model) study measuring whether INT4/INT8 quantization changes what a language model memorizes and how reliably it recalls facts. INT4 leaves factual accuracy statistically unchanged (replicated null); memorization is driven by model scale, not precision. Includes cross-modality external validation (diffusion image fidelity + LLM factuality).
